welcome.title: Let Agents Connect Securely
welcome.lede:
Let Grok Bot and Muse in the cloud use Claude Code and Codex on your computer,
and give specialist tasks to specialist agents.
welcome.promise: Even if the server is breached, attackers can’t reach your computer. Tasks are end-to-end encrypted, so the server never sees your content.

browser.title: Complete Sign-In in Your Browser
browser.body: You’ll return here automatically when you’re done. Signing in for the first time creates your account with no password needed.

selfHosted.title: Connect Your Own Server
selfHosted.body: Enter the address of the Hermesh server you deployed, along with the claim code shown when it first started.
selfHosted.plain: Not encrypted (HTTP). Your tasks remain end-to-end encrypted, but the claim code and online machine status travel in plain text. Anyone on the network could read them or claim this server before you do, and Claude and ChatGPT won't be able to connect. This is fine for testing on a trusted network, but add a domain with HTTPS for ongoing use.

authorize.titleTrust: Make This Mac Your Trusted Device?
authorize.titleTrust_win: Make This PC Your Trusted Device?
authorize.titleTrust_linux: Make This Computer Your Trusted Device?
authorize.body: Hermesh only does what’s listed below. It never changes system settings or reads your files.
authorize.trustedBody: Creates your owner key inside this Mac’s Secure Enclave, where it never leaves the device. Whenever an environment or agent wants to connect, you approve with Touch ID here.
authorize.trustedBody_win: Creates your owner key inside this PC’s security chip (TPM), where it never leaves the device. Whenever an environment or agent wants to connect, you approve with Windows Hello here.
authorize.trustedBody_linux: Creates your owner key on this computer, kept by Hermesh’s signing service, which no other program can read. Whenever an environment or agent wants to connect, you approve it here with your password.
authorize.trustedOff: Off: no owner key is stored here. This Mac only runs tasks, cannot approve requests, and cannot see your other environments. Ideal for a work Mac.
authorize.trustedOff_win: Off: no owner key is stored here. This PC only runs tasks, cannot approve requests, and cannot see your other environments. Ideal for a work PC.
authorize.trustedOff_linux: Off: no owner key is stored here. This computer only runs tasks, cannot approve requests, and cannot see your other environments. Ideal for a work computer.
authorize.shareBody: Hermesh runs Claude Code and Codex from the command line just as you do. It never reads API keys or tokens, or touches your agent sign-ins. When turned off, you can still use your other environments and turn this on later in Settings.
